calls.title: Tatev Torabyan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team reviewed their competitor campaign strategies, noting low traffic despite audience adjustments. Tatev's removal of company size targeting did not yield results, leading to a new plan to focus on direct competitor brand keywords such as Optimizely and Adobe Target. The integration of offline conversion tracking with Google Ads is underway to enhance algorithm effectiveness and lead measurement. Additionally, segments from Google Ads landing page visitors will support LinkedIn retargeting, though current segments are limited. A proposal to create tech-based audiences for LinkedIn was also discussed, prioritizing website traffic as a stronger targeting signal. Finally, the team evaluated competitors' ad spend levels and proposed developing blog content to attract developers towards B testing tool evaluations.
calls.keywords: Competitor Campaign, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Audience Segmentation, Competitor Spend, AB Testing

calls.title: Tatev Torabyan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed significant updates regarding their marketing efforts, emphasizing improvements in campaign efficiency with the introduction of new landing pages aimed at resolving quality score issues within two to three weeks. Current performance metrics revealed that the branded campaign maintained a stable 7% CTR but was lacking recorded leads, prompting a strategy to retarget visitors for improved conversions. Insights from the Feature Flag campaign showed near double CTR enhancements achieved through tighter keyword targeting and competitor filtering. Additionally, integrating Rio's data streamlines lead prioritization based on activity surges and fit metrics, while budget constraints necessitate efficient targeting rather than increased spend, impacting impression share significantly. The upcoming Khan Academy webinar was also highlighted as relevant content to promote.

calls.title: Tatev Torabyan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team discussed the stability of Google Ads campaigns, highlighting improvements in performance from strategic changes led by Tatev Torabyan. It was noted that campaign growth surged from 47 to 166 accounts, spurred by experimental campaigns. Updates to landing pages are scheduled to go live next Thursday, aiming to improve messaging and performance, particularly in pricing presentation. Additionally, a shift in the pricing model from per-seat to event-based is planned for next month to enhance user predictability. There are also plans for a retargeting campaign targeting interested visitors with richer content to boost conversion rates. Finally, metrics from Google Ads were shared, revealing an 18% growth in accounts over 90 days and a current click-to-contact rate of 30%.

calls.title: Tatev Torabyan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team reviewed their successful integration of HubSpot CRM with Google Ads, allowing better tracking of lead-to-opportunity conversions at a cost of around $265. They acknowledged strong competition from LaunchDarkly in branded campaigns and planned adjustments to improve ad group quality scores. An experimentation campaign showed a CTR of 1.9%, prompting a strategic shift to focus on 20 key states and cities to enhance engagement. Messaging for feature flags was prioritized for engineers based on market feedback, with discussions on emphasizing pricing and unique selling points. Data segmentation challenges were also noted, with plans to refine audience targeting and collaboration with a LinkedIn ad agency for improved messaging strategies moving forward.
